panels.art: One second later on the balcony. Bell at the LEFT, eight, fully clothed, black coat, tiny brass bell on the collar, both hands on the rail, curious, not afraid, ordinary proportions. Dan at the CENTRE has both hands up, empty, not touching her. Odessa at the RIGHT stands a step behind the child, hands folded, scale brooch with no letters, smile that does not reach the eyes. Night lamps. No one hurt.

lines.ru: Девочка ещё не договорила. На балконе над ней — женщина, которая это имя купила. Аукцион был не за именем. Он был за учителем.

lines.en: I am Lina. Who are you?
lines.delivery: the same polite child voice, unfinished from last night

lines.en: The auction is open. Come in.
lines.delivery: soft, gracious, never louder than a contract

panels.art: The auction hall: dark wood, tiered seats full of grey coats, a central pedestal with nothing on it. Odessa at the LEFT, hands still folded. Dan at the CENTRE stares at the empty stand, both hands open. Mira at the RIGHT, arms folded, red cord on the left wrist. Blank cream sheets with brass seals and no letters. Deep blacks.

lines.en: Lot seven is not here.
lines.delivery: pleasant, as if announcing tea

lines.en: Where is the lot? You called us.
lines.delivery: public, angry, the galleries listening

lines.en: The lot was the trap. Look.
lines.delivery: deadpan, already done with the room

panels.art: Wide humiliation shot. A citizen at the LEFT laughs behind a hand, the other hand pointing at the empty pedestal. Dan at the CENTRE stands small in the middle of the floor, pale, both fists closed. Odessa at the RIGHT does not laugh, hands folded, the stillest person in the hall. Tiered crowd. No child in this frame.

lines.en: No lot. The auction watched you.
lines.ru: Лота нет. Аукцион смотрел на тебя.
lines.delivery: a laugh in the throat, cruel and ordinary

lines.en: The offer is a contract. Listen.
lines.delivery: sweet, the trap closing without a sound

lines.en: The auction is a trap.
lines.delivery: flat, late on purpose, no help in it

panels.art: Two-shot across the empty pedestal. Odessa at the LEFT, half-moon glasses on a chain, one hand open in a polite offer, the other at her waist. Dan at the RIGHT does not take it, both hands at his sides, the gap between them clear. Brass lamp, no text on the blank contract sheets.

lines.en: You teach my people. You own nothing.
lines.ru: Ты учишь моих людей. Тебе ничего не принадлежит.
lines.delivery: each clause a term, voice even

lines.en: The phone is the pay. A return is a promise.
lines.delivery: the sweet part, still not a smile that reaches the eyes

lines.en: I do not agree. I refuse the offer.
lines.delivery: public, shaking, the two words chosen

panels.art: Thorn at the LEFT, small, pen out, nothing red but the nib, cane in the other hand. Odessa at the CENTRE turns her head only, body still. Dan at the RIGHT watches the pen, hopeful. The crowd is a dark ring. No contact between the women.

lines.en: A promise is not a door, dear.
lines.delivery: the correction aimed at Odessa, dear kept for Dan

lines.en: Did you teach the girl her name?
lines.delivery: polite cross-examination, did you almost swallowed

lines.en: Did someone pay you? The market did.
lines.delivery: answering her own question, a smile at last

panels.art: Dan at the LEFT in the middle of the floor, both hands open to the crowd, glasses flashing. Mira at the RIGHT stands at his shoulder, not touching, red cord visible, chin up. The empty pedestal between them and Odessa, who is out of frame. Hard rim light.

lines.en: I did not teach her. I did not sell.
lines.ru: Я её не учил. Я не продавал.
lines.delivery: loud enough for the back row, honest

lines.en: Did you steal from the market?
lines.delivery: from off-frame, silk over a knife

panels.art: Closer on Dan at the CENTRE, the crowd a blur, both hands open and empty. Mira at the RIGHT is at the edge of frame, red cord on the left wrist, watching him not the gallery. Hard light on his face. No child.

lines.ru: Пустой постамент — это унижение. Контракт — цена выхода. Телефон мамы лежит в этой цене, и Дэн его не берёт.

lines.en: I did not steal.
lines.delivery: the refusal already said, this one is only the truth

panels.art: Close horror. Odessa at the LEFT holds Dan's old phone in one hand, the other hand at her collar, mouth open, eyes wrong for a second, the gracious mask slipped. Dan at the RIGHT recoils, both hands up, not touching her. The phone is dark, no screen text, no icons. Vermilion rim on her glasses.

lines.en: Dan. Eat.
lines.delivery: a stranger's mother-voice forced through her mouth, she does not notice

lines.en: That is not Mom. Stop.
lines.delivery: cracked, the worst sound in the tower

lines.en: Mother.
lines.delivery: from the gallery, one word, the boy under the coat

panels.art: Ruk at the CENTRE has stepped onto the floor between his mother and Dan, tall, coat open, both gloved hands empty, ledger still under his arm, he does not sit. Odessa at the LEFT looks at him as a number, hands folded again, the voice-slip gone. Dan at the RIGHT watches Ruk, stunned. No child.

lines.en: You are a number, Ansel. Sit.
lines.delivery: ice, the name used as a leash, still not loud

lines.en: I do not sit. I do not agree.
lines.ru: Я не сяду. Я не согласен.
lines.delivery: quiet, the first no she has had from him

lines.en: Did you agree to the contract?
lines.delivery: to Ruk, almost kind, a real question

panels.art: Thorn at the LEFT raises the pen like a bar, both feet planted, cane hooked on her arm. Dan at the CENTRE nods. Mira at the RIGHT is already turning toward a side door, one hand out. A blank System window, solid red frame, hangs over the pedestal. Crowd uneasy.

lines.en: Did we refuse the contract, dear? We did.
lines.ru: Мы отказались от контракта, дорогой? Отказались.
lines.delivery: the model question and answer, crisp, for the whole hall

lines.en: We did. I refuse. I own my no.
lines.delivery: steadier, the engineer signing with his voice

lines.en: The offer is closed. The return is not yours.
lines.delivery: flat penalty, the door home shut in one line

panels.art: Action, no children. Tally at the LEFT, patched black-and-white cloak sewn with keys and spoons, no letters, white streak in her hair, dumps a sack of amber jars with both hands. Nad at the CENTRE, smooth head, one teal seam, no eyes, no nose, no lips, arms open, jars breaking into vermilion motes around him, not blood. Dan at the RIGHT ducks, both arms over his head, not touching them. Deep blacks.

lines.en: A lot of jars. Not your lot.
lines.delivery: amused, counting, the two meanings of lot in one breath

lines.en: Did you open the vault? Did he?
lines.delivery: shouting over the crack of glass

panels.art: A dark phone has slid to Dan's boot. He crouches at the LEFT, both hands around the phone, no screen text, the glass black. Mira at the RIGHT kneels beside him but her hands stay on her own knees, red cord visible. Amber shards around them, no one unconscious. A blank System window glows.

lines.en: The phone is yours. Missed calls: 31.
lines.delivery: flat, the number heavier than the reward

lines.en: Mom did call. I did not answer.
lines.delivery: wrecked whisper, seventeen missed days in one line

lines.en: Count: 262.
lines.delivery: a second stamp, no comfort beside the thirty-one

panels.art: The hall starting to groan, beams not yet falling. Ruk at the LEFT stands where his mother stood, both hands empty, coat dusty with amber light. Dan at the CENTRE holds the phone to his chest with both hands. Mira at the RIGHT looks up at the ceiling, one hand on a pillar. No child.

lines.en: The promise is a trap. We refused.
lines.delivery: pulling him, no time for the phone

lines.en: I refused her. I do not own you.
lines.ru: Я отказал ей. Ты мне не принадлежишь.
lines.delivery: awkward, the nearest thing he has to a hand offered

lines.en: Did she pay you to sit? You didn't.
lines.ru: Она платила тебе, чтобы ты сел? Ты не сел.
lines.delivery: a rough thanks, almost a joke

panels.art: Nad rises at the CENTRE from the broken light, still one seam, smooth head, no eyes, no hair, no nose, no lips, jars orbiting as sparks. Dan at the RIGHT holds the phone down, both hands tight, unable to look away. Teal only on the seam. No child. No blood.

lines.en: I did not sell.
lines.delivery: Dan's voice, exact, thrown back at him

lines.en: I did not steal.
lines.delivery: same voice, a second denial, emptier

panels.art: The second and third seams split the smooth head, still no eyes, no nose, no lips, no hair, three thin vertical teal lines only. Nad at the LEFT, shoulders a little narrower, exactly two arms. Thorn at the RIGHT has the pen half raised and stops, both hands still, face tight. Black hall, vermilion motes.

lines.ru: Третий шов открывается без глаз и без рта. Фраза, которой Дэн не жил, звучит его голосом.

lines.en: I did not leave.
lines.delivery: three voices, one of them Dan's, the sentence he never lived

lines.en: I do not say leave. I didn't.
lines.ru: Я не говорю «уходить». Я не говорил.
lines.delivery: desperate, the new word already in the air

panels.art: Black. Only Nad, Chorus, three teal seams on a smooth head, no eyes, no sockets, no nose, no lips, no hair, mustard scrap at the throat, phone-light on Dan's fingers at the very edge and no readable screen. The figure is too close. Two arms, hands open.

lines.en: I did not leave.
lines.delivery: the three seams together, soft, the cliff in Dan's own voice

lines.en: Not true. He did not say it.
lines.delivery: flat, agreeing with Dan and accusing the Chorus in one line

grammarNote.title: Did you...? / didn't
grammarNote.body: Did ставит вопрос к прошлому: Did you teach her? Did someone pay you? Ответ короткий: I did или I did not / I didn't. Отрицание — did not перед обычным глаголом: I did not sell. I did not steal. Did не меняет глагол, окончание -ed сюда не добавляют. Lot на аукционе — не «много», а вещь, которую продают. A lot of по-прежнему значит «много».

examples.en: Did you teach the girl her name?
Did we refuse the contract, dear? We did.
examples.ru: Мы отказались от контракта, дорогой? Отказались.

examples.en: I did not teach her. I did not sell.
examples.ru: Я её не учил. Я не продавал.

quiz.q: Почему зал пуст, хотя все ждали лот «имя ребёнка»?
options: Лота нет: Одессе нужен был Дэн

quiz.q: Что в контракте и что делает Дэн?
options: Учить людей Ledger, ничего не иметь, телефон в уплату — и он отказывается

quiz.q: Что случается с голосом Одессы у телефона?
options: На одну фразу говорит чужим голосом: Dan. Eat.

quiz.q: Какую фразу Chorus говорит такой, какой Дэн не жил?
